content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIIT Bhagalpur Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Information Technology Bhagalpur (IIIT Bhagalpur) for a DST-sponsored research project based in Bihar.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The post announced in this notification is Junior Research Fellow (JRF). It is a project-based temporary position requiring specialized technical qualifications.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position under this specific recruitment advertisement number IITBH/R&C/506/2026/62.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection mode for IIIT Bhagalpur JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment is completely based on a Walk-in Interview. Eligible candidates can directly appear for the interview on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post at IIIT Bhagalpur is scheduled to take place on 09 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E/B.Tech or M.E/M.Tech in relevant engineering branches such as ECE, EEE, CSE, Quantum, VLSI, or Microelectronics with at least 65% marks or 6.5 CGPA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or monthly stipend offered to the selected candidate?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month throughout the project duration.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No application fee is required to be paid by the candidates, as no fee has been mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original certificates, self-attested photocopies of academic and experience records, research publications, a valid photo identity proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Indian Institute of Information Technology Bhagalpur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Information Technology Bhagalpur is located in Bhagalpur, Bihar, with the postal pincode 813210, where the walk-in interview process will be conducted.
